Cats Luv Us Boarding Hotel is centrally located in Laguna Niguel, making us easily accessible from cities throughout South Orange County. Select your city below to learn more about our services in your area.

props.heading: Conveniently Located in Laguna Niguel
props.content:
Our facility at 27601 Forbes Rd, Laguna Niguel, CA 92677 is centrally located in South Orange County, making us an easy drive from communities throughout the region. Whether you’re coming from Mission Viejo to the north, Dana Point to the south, or Irvine to the northeast, most of our clients reach us within 15 to 20 minutes.

We’ve been serving the South Orange County area since 1993, building lasting relationships with cat owners in every city we serve. Our reputation for exceptional, cat-exclusive care has made us the go-to choice for thousands of feline families across the region.

We welcome cats from all over Orange County and beyond. If your city isn’t listed above, chances are we still serve your area. Give us a call at (949) 582-1732 and we’ll let you know how we can help.

Many of our clients travel from as far as San Clemente, Rancho Santa Margarita, Laguna Hills, Foothill Ranch, and even Newport Beach because they value our cat-only approach and 30+ years of specialized experience. Quality cat care is worth the drive!

props.heading: Here for You When You Need Us Most!
props.content:
No matter the hour, you can trust Cats Luv Us to be there for your cat. From holiday boarding to last-minute stays, we're always ready to help.

We guarantee your cat's comfort, safety, and happiness. If you're not completely satisfied with our care, we'll make it right—no questions asked.

Before we begin any service, we discuss your options so you know exactly what you're getting and how much it costs. No hidden fees, no surprises.

We understand your time is valuable. We promise to honor your scheduled drop-off and pick-up windows, or your next day of boarding is free.
